posts.text:
My NFL Today’s Picks (Week 8 – 2026 Season)

Well in the crazy world of the National Football League, there is no shortage of headlines within the league. But also it does comes with more surprises than a typical Lifetime movie. The NFC East division is going to look different by season’s end. The Philadelphia Eagles have now lost 5 in a row, and the fans want some answers. I have a feeling that someone is going to pay dearly for the Eagles failures this season. Could be the head coach Nick Sirianni that may fall on the sword of the unemployment line, if he can’t turn there season around. Now the NFC East may come down to the Dallas Cowboys or even the New York Giants? This should be an interesting the rest of the NFL season. What happened to the Kansas City Chiefs Sunday Night? The Seahawks just shocked the football world in knocking off the Chiefs from the ranks of the Undefeated and did it so decisively. It was so bad that Patrick Mahommes was so upset at his team after the game, I wish I could play the audio of it but it is too colorful for my liking. Well my picks was not as great as I hoped after going 7-7 in Week 7, and no it is not a slot machine theme I got going. In the month of October I am 37-21-1, and on the 2026 season so far I am 63-43-1. So let’s get to Week 8 NFL picks shall we:Thursday Night Football on Amazon Prime Video: (Kickoff @ 8:00pmEDT)Carolina Panthers over Green Bay PackersEarly Sunday Afternoon Kickoff: (The 1:00pmEDT Games)*Games on CBS Sports*Buffalo Bills over Baltimore RavensCincinnati Bengals over Tennessee TitansPitsburgh Steelers over Cleveland BrownsJacksonville Jaguars over Indianapolis Colts*Games on FOX Sports*Dallas Cowboys over Arizona CardinalsDetroit Lions over Minnesota VikingsLas Vegas Raiders over New York JetsTampa Bay Buccaneers over Atlanta FalconsLate Sunday Afternoon Kickoff: (The 4:00pmEDT or later games)Los Angeles Rams over Los Angeles Chargers (Game on FOX Sports)Kansas City Chiefs over Denver Broncos (Game on CBS Sports)New England Patriots over Miami Dolphins (Game on CBS Sports)(Remember to always check your local listings on what game you are getting in your area, if you don’t have NFL Sunday ticket via Youtube TV)Sunday Night Football on NBC and Peacock: (Kickoff @ 8:00pmEDT)Philadelphia Eagles over Washington CommandersMonday Night Football on ESPN: (Kickoff @ 8:00pmEDT)Seattle Seahawks over Chicago BearsThere you have it as my NFL picks are up, and on the board here for your viewing pleasure. Well let’s get back to a football winning weekend and Happy Halloween to you. Be safe out there!

Seahawks OT Charles Cross, who suffered an ankle injury on Sunday, has a high-ankle sprain and will miss time, the MRI revealed.

The hope is he’s back in 1-2 weeks, but it depends on how rehab goes.

Packers LB Zaire Franklin, who missed last week’s game after getting accidentally kicked in practice, suffered a hairline fracture in his leg, sources say.

Green Bay did not place him on Injured Reserve, and they believe he can return while missing minimal games.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Patriots are releasing their punter from the previous three seasons, Bryce Baringer, source says. He’s been on Injured Reserve, but is healthy now.

Packers C Sean Rhyan, who left Sunday’s game with an ankle injury, is believed to have suffered a high-ankle sprain, sources say. 

X-Rays were negative, and he has an MRI today. But high-ankle sprains are often 4-6 week injuries

posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.
